create_SimplexIntervalBound: create a SimplexIntervalBound with lower and upper interval tensors and a simplex sum constraint
test_from_jittable: test converting a JittableInputBound to a SimplexIntervalBound using from_jittable
test_project_onto_bound: test projecting a tensor onto the SimplexIntervalBound using project_onto_bound
run_concretize_linear_function: run concretize_linear_function_simplexinterval_constraints to compute the lower bound of a linear function under simplex constraints
run_concretizing_input: run concretizing_input_simplexinterval_constraints to compute the input that achieves the lower bound of a linear function
